notes: 4 photos: a lunch board, a dinner board, and two shots of the same breakfast menu (one flat scan, one photographed on a table) which were merged as duplicates. Items repeated across the lunch and dinner boards (soup, flatbreads, salads, Soleil Burger) were merged rather than duplicated, keeping the more detailed wording. All four photos were legible printed menus.
